docs.title: Welcome to Plutus Debugger
docs.text: The Plutus Debugger VSCode Plugin brings professional debugging tools to Cardano smart contract developers. Built to provide step-through debugging, variable inspection, and breakpoint capabilities directly within your favorite IDE.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Breakpoints: Set breakpoints in your Plutus (Haskell) code.
  • Variable Inspection: View the current state of variables on the stack.
  • Gas Profiling: Track ExUnits consumption across execution.
  • Simulation: Test scripts with mock ledger states before deploying.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Check out our API Reference for available commands or see the Troubleshooting guide if you run into issues.

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text: The Plutus Debugger provides several VSCode commands and settings to customize your debugging experience.

docs.title: plutus-debugger.startDebugging
docs.text: Starts a debugging session for the currently active Plutus script.

docs.title: plutus-debugger.profileGas
docs.text: Runs the current script and generates a gas profiling report showing ExUnits used.

docs.title: Configuration Options
docs.text:
In your .vscode/launch.json or .vscode/settings.json, you can configure the debugger:

  • plutus.debugger.endpoint: URL to the local or remote Plutus compilation/simulation endpoint.
  • plutus.debugger.logLevel: Logging level (info, debug, error).
  • plutus.debugger.network: Cardano network to simulate (mainnet, preprod, preview).

docs.title: What versions of Plutus does this plugin support?
docs.text: We support Plutus V1, Plutus V2, and the recently released Plutus V3.

docs.title: Can I debug directly on-chain?
docs.text: No. The debugger runs locally against an offline node or simulator. On-chain debugging is not supported as the ledger does not emit granular execution traces in real-time.

docs.title: Does it support Aiken?
docs.text: Currently, the plugin focuses on Plutus Tx (Haskell). Aiken has its own set of toolchains, though we plan to add Aiken trace format support in the future.

docs.title: Where can I report bugs?
docs.text: Please report bugs on our GitHub Issues page.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: If you encounter issues while using the Plutus Debugger, please refer to these common solutions.

docs.title: Debugger Fails to Attach
docs.text: Symptom: The debugging session starts but immediately closes. Solution: 1. Check that you have compiled your Plutus script with debug flags enabled. 2. Ensure no other service is binding to the debugger port (default 4711). 3. Check the output logs via View -> Output -> Plutus Debugger.

docs.title: Inaccurate Gas Estimates
docs.text: Symptom: The profiler reports 0 ExUnits or significantly lower than expected. Solution: This usually happens if you are evaluating an empty script or a mock transaction without context. Ensure your mock data (sample_cost.json etc.) contains realistic datum and redeemer values.

docs.title: Plutus V3 Unsupported Errors
docs.text: Symptom: You see an error about PlutusV3 unsupported features. Solution: Upgrade the extension to the latest version. Plutus V3 support was stabilized in 0.2.x.
